name: alstate
description: Workspace for the Alstate headless learning scheduling runtime.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @alstate/core && npm run build -w @alstate/sqlite && npm run build -w @alstate/fsrs && npm run build -w @alstate/vocabulary-example
scripts.check: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check:boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && node --eval "require('node:fs').rmSync('.integration-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @alstate/core && npm run test -w @alstate/sqlite && npm run test -w @alstate/fsrs && npm run test -w @alstate/vocabulary-example && npm run test:integration
